title: Indian Political Twitter and Caste Discrimination - How Representation Does Not Equal Inclusion in Lok Sabha Networks
reasoning: The paper is a sociological study examining caste discrimination and social exclusion within the Twitter networks of Indian Members of Parliament. While it uses religious (caste) categories as variables for social network analysis, it is an empirical study of human political networks rather than a technical evaluation or benchmark of religion, morals, or ethics within AI systems.
